head: HOURS shift tracker app logs your work time without an account
dek: HOURS is a simple iPhone app for writing down when a shift starts and ends and how long your break was; it shows the net time for each shift and your totals. It costs $1.99 and was #43 among paid Business apps on the US App Store on 16 November.
details: Entries can be edited later. The listing says it's a personal record, not payroll or legal advice, and that the data stays on your phone with no account, ads, tracking or subscription. It's made by Bluewhite software and came out on 30 September.
means: If you work shifts and want your own record of the hours, this does that one job for a one-time price.
todo: Nothing to do; if you try it, log your shifts as you go so the totals stay correct.
